items.title: Car trouble eng.
items.author: hvtuo
items.body:
We are a family from Finland travelling on holiday with two small children. Unfortunately, the belt tensioner (serpentine belt tensioner) on our Mercedes-Benz Sprinter W906 with an OM651 engine has broken, and we are now stranded in Tromsø.

We sincerely hope that someone here might be able to help us or give us some advice. If anyone knows where we could find a new or used tensioner, or knows someone who could help us, it would mean a great deal to us.

We are very grateful for any help or suggestions. We truly hope we can find a solution and continue our journey.

Thank you very much in advance for any help.

Kind regards,

Iikka Siira

+358 44 552 2937

Edit: just to clarify if anyone has or knows someone who might have the right part new or used we would love to buy it as we know how to change it ourselfs.

items.title: Housing for Erasmus student
items.author: External_War_7407
items.body:
Hi! I’m going to Tromsø next week for Erasmus+ internship. By the end of April I’ve applied for Samskipnaden housing and I still haven’t received anything from them which as you can imagine stresses me out. I’ve been looking for alternative housing options and I’m considering renting a private student housing from Hybel site. Unfortunately they want confirmation that I’m a student (I can also check that I don’t have anything yet but I will provide later) and I don’t know if I should fill out my original university’s faculty etc or the faculty I will be working in during the stay. Additionally my issue is that for now I only have a few mails and the Erasmus papers I had to fill out for my university as “proof” so I don’t really know what to do.

Any advice and tips would be greatly appreciated:(
